column3: “Answered and said” is rendered “answered.”
“Did someone attempt a word” is rendered “If one ventures a word.”
“Instructed” is rendered “admonished,” and “slack hands” as “weak hands.”
“Your words raised the stumbling” is rendered “Your words have helped the tottering to stand,” and “bending knees” as “feeble knees.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Your fear” is rendered “your fear of God”; NASB reorders the parallel.
Close to the Hebrew.
“Wickedness” is rendered “iniquity,” and “mischief” as “trouble.”
“Breath of his anger” is rendered “blast of His anger.”
The second word for lion is rendered “fierce lion”; the exact meaning of the lion words is uncertain.
“Because not prey” is rendered “for lack of prey.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
“The multitude of my bones” is rendered “all my bones.”
“A wind” is rendered “a spirit.”
“A whisper and a voice” is rendered “There was silence, then … a voice.”
“From God … from his Maker” is rendered “before God … before his Maker”; it may also mean “more than God.”
“Messengers” is rendered “angels.” The meaning of the word for “error” is uncertain.
“Also” is rendered “How much more,” and “people crush them” as “Who are crushed.”
“Because not one who sets” is rendered “Unobserved”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Tent cord” is rendered “tent-cord”; the Hebrew word may also mean “excess.”
